title: Clicked
summary: Cut account creation from 4 clicks to 1 and rebuilt onboarding for a career-learning platform, later acquired by Ziplines Education.
intro: Clicked helps people gain career experience through hands-on learning and coaching. Its sign-up and onboarding were long and confusing, and the product was split across several disconnected systems. As the lead product designer, working directly with the CEO and Head of Product, I redesigned the journey from the marketing site through sign-up, onboarding and the learning experience itself.
body:
## Key objectives

- Shorten the path from the marketing site to a learner’s first experience.
- Unify several disconnected systems into one clear product.
- Put Clicked’s core offering, its learning experiences, front and center.

## Mapping the journeys

I audited the three ways people arrived: organic site visitors, sign-ups from a specific learning experience, and learners entering through a partner program. Each had long forms, unclear navigation and dashboards that didn’t connect. I defined an ideal path for each, cut account creation from 4 clicks to 1, and replaced the long form with a step-by-step onboarding wizard.

![Old and new user flows](/images/clicked/flows-portfolio.png)

*The user flows before and after.*

![Early wireframe sketch](/images/clicked/screenshot-2025-07-29-at-2.42.32-pm.png)

*An early wireframe with annotations.*

## One product instead of several

I designed the landing pages, the dashboard, program pages and an improved learning experience, bringing separate systems into a single platform built on Clicked’s design system components. Learners can now join an experience, track their progress in one dashboard and find coaches and skills without getting lost.

![Original landing page](/images/clicked/landing-before.webp)
![Redesigned landing page](/images/clicked/new-landing-abbreviated.png)

*Landing page, before (left) and after (right).*

![Original dashboard](/images/clicked/dashboard-before.webp)
![Redesigned dashboard](/images/clicked/final.png)

*Dashboard, before (left) and after (right).*

![Final coaches page](/images/clicked/coaches.png)

*Coaches.*

![Final skills page](/images/clicked/skills.png)

*Skills.*

## An AI prototype in four days

Midway through the project, the CEO needed a new AI-powered learning experience for an investor pitch, within a week. I sketched the flows and prototyped an experience where learners get real-time feedback from GPT, and delivered a polished prototype in four days.

In this solo practice, a learner works through four stages: a scenario, supporting material, a deliverable to submit, and completion. When they submit their work, here a user story for a Salesforce-sponsored business analyst challenge, GPT gives specific feedback right away, and each point links to the coaching video clips that explain it.

![AI feedback on a submitted user story, with supporting coach video clips](/images/clicked/ai-feedback-prototype.webp)

*The AI feedback prototype: instant feedback on a submitted user story, linked to coach videos.*

The prototype was ready for the pitch, and the pitch went well.

## Outcome

Account creation went from 4 clicks to 1, onboarding became a single guided flow, and Clicked had one consistent design foundation to build new learning experiences on. Within a year, Clicked was acquired by Ziplines Education.
